description: Generate evidence-linked scientific document cards from PDF folders.

features.name: initialize-application
features.title: Initialize the application
features.description: Set up the application with the necessary dependencies and configuration.
acceptance: Discover all PDFs in the supplied directory and process them in order.
Use an llm service, Ollama Qwen3:14b model to extract the central claims for each chunk if exists and generate one compact card per document.
Generate a single JSON file containing all the cards.
Grafana dashboard to visualize the cards and logs.
langfuse integration to capture traces and logs from ollama qwen3:14b
